程序包 io.papermc.paper.plugin.lifecycle.event.handler.configuration

接口 LifecycleEventHandlerConfiguration<O extends LifecycleEventOwner>

类型参数:
O -
所有已知子接口:
MonitorLifecycleEventHandlerConfiguration<O>, PrioritizedLifecycleEventHandlerConfiguration<O>, RegistryEntryAddConfiguration<T>
@NonExtendable public interface LifecycleEventHandlerConfiguration<O extends LifecycleEventOwner>
为生命周期事件构造已配置事件处理器的基础类型。通常通过 LifecycleEventType.newHandler(LifecycleEventHandler) 由 LifecycleEvents 中的事件类型创建
